page.overview:
Who is Gigas?

Gigas is the altered form of Katarina Alves' adoptive father. Prior to his transformation into Gigas, he adopted Katarina from the orphanage she was sent to after the deaths of her parents. Though she was initially rebellious, his kindness got through to her, and the two of them grew close. He taught Katarina in the art of savate before his sudden disappearance.

He disappeared after being captured by G Corporation. He was experimented on and mutated into a red hulking beast through the use of other fighter's DNA, becoming the creature known as Gigas. G-Corporation intended to use him as a biotechnological weapon, and the research wing working on him considered themselves rivals to the department working on the Jack robots. Gigas was entered into the King of the Iron Fist Tournament in order to test his fighting capabilities, and was pitted against Katarina, who had entered the tournament in the hopes of winning the cash prize so she could search for her 'missing' father.

Gigas' personality lingers more to an animalistic side than human, being only able to make sub-human grunts, shouts and gurgles. However, in both his and Katarina's endings, Gigas finally shows a little of his humanity left in him whenever he sees Katarina's presence. Like Devil Jin, Gigas also suffers from headaches, though this is when he sees his adoptive daughter, Katarina.

Gigas is a large red male behemoth creature with a mirrored helmet consisting of six "eyes" with a matching black steel collar. If one is to look closely, a glimpse of Gigas's mouth may be caught on some occasions. Most of his body is covered in large black pieces of armor, gauntlets and shoulder pads over his red skin, with numerous loose cables sticking out of his back.
